claims: Restore copies into a private same-parent staging directory and runs SQLite PRAGMA quick_check there before promotion.
A failed integrity check removes only the staging directory created by that restore call and leaves the final destination absent.
A successful restore is promoted with a same-parent rename after rechecking that the final destination is absent.
Restore destinations equal to or nested under the backup source fail closed before mutation.
limitations: This is a single-filesystem local atomic-promotion claim; it does not establish off-host retention, staging recovery, production rollback, signing, deployment, or activation.
The destination-absence check and rename rely on the local filesystem namespace; callers must not concurrently create the same restore destination.
